newsitem.title: UK: U.K. Intervention Board details EU sugar sales.
newsitem.headline: U.K. Intervention Board details EU sugar sales.

text.p: A total 29,750 tonnes of current series white sugar received export rebates of a maximum 46.854 European Currency Units (Ecus) per 100 kilos at Wednesday's European Union (EU) tender, the U.K. Intervention Board said.
Out of this, traders in France received 15,500 tonnes, in Denmark 5,000, in Belgium 4,250, in the U.K. 3,000 and in Germany 2,000 tonnes, it added.
Earlier on Wednesday, London traders had expected the subsidy for the current season whites campaign for licences to be 46.854 Ecus per 100 kilos.
Traders had also forecast the total authorised sugar tonnage export awards to be between 40,000 and 70,000 tonnes versus 31,000 last week when the restitution was 46.690 Ecus.
